title: The Great Hunt: The Pale Weaver

texts.details:
You have a companion, and you can loose an arrow. You think that makes you a hunter. It makes you an archer with a pet.

A hunter knows one creature as a priestess knows her prayers. We will begin with one. The webwood spiders. Take six of the venomfangs in the woods west of here. Do not hurry. Watch how they wait, and how long.

When you know them, go north to the lake. There is one there that the Sentinels have named: the Pale Weaver. She is old and she is patient. Be more patient, $N, and you will have begun the Great Hunt.
texts.objectives: Kill 6 Webwood Venomfangs and then The Pale Weaver, in the webbed woods of Teldrassil. Return to your trainer when it is done.
texts.progress: A spider does not chase. Remember that when you choose your ground.
texts.completion:
The Pale Weaver. I had begun to think she would outlive me.

Here is the first lesson, and it is not written anywhere: you cannot hunt a thing well without coming to respect it. Those who want only the kill never become good.

There is a Great Hunt, $N, as old as our craft. Six beasts, each harder and further off than the last. This was the first. Choose one of these, and take up the trail again when you have twenty seasons of sense. Others will guide you from there.

idea: The Great Hunt, level 10 (Alliance): the hunter's first true hunt, of one old beast the trainer names. Invented: The Pale Weaver.
